mobbin:157d0155-3762-4ce7-81c3-aead25729.summary: From a board’s Subscribe popover (empty Email/Slack), user opens Create a Subscription, picks Weekly + day/time/timezone, adds a recipient via search, and is ready to Subscribe.
steps: Subscribe popover — Email/Slack empty + Create New
Subscriber chip listed — Send Test available
steal: Subscribe lives on the board chrome next to Share (step 0) — subscribe the view you’re looking at.
Email vs Slack tabs in one modal (steps 1–4) — channel without a second flow.
Send Test beside Subscribers (steps 1–4) — verify digest before go-live.
Empty state ‘No email subscriptions found for this board’ + Create New (step 0).
avoid: Full day + time + timezone before any default (steps 1–2) — clashes with zero-config weekly dean digests.
mobbin:157d0155-3762-4ce7-81c3-aead25729.fit: Board-level subscribe → automatic weekly/monthly email for deans; extends today’s hand-pulled reports without a builder.

mobbin:5d067428-a757-489e-83a9-b33e2d63e.summary: User builds an Insights query with two metrics, country filter, and nested device×cohort breakdown, then switches Manual Segments and toggles cohort visibility on chart + pivot table.
steps: Cohort rows toggled — chart series update
steal: Nested Metric → device type → cohort rows with Average + day columns (steps 0–3) — matrix comparable by segment.
Color checkboxes in the table drive chart lines (steps 1–3) — one control for both views.
Breakdown chips in the query rail (device type, cohort) (all steps) — segments named, not buried in filters.
avoid: Full query builder (metrics + filter + breakdown) as the first cut (all steps) — Baseline favours zero-config defaults over deep builders.
mobbin:5d067428-a757-489e-83a9-b33e2d63e.fit: Maps to Performance Matrix / Group Performance cohort compare by course·year·learner — ship as defaults, not free-form Insights.

mobbin:09f6e5da-eaa5-4633-9a33-231f80031.summary: From an Insights chart, user opens Compare → Time Period, picks Previous day (or other presets), then sees Past Avg columns and green/red % deltas vs the prior period.
steps: Compare menu — Time Period / Segment / % Overall
Compare to previous day on — Past Avg columns
Table shows colour % change vs prior period
steal: Compare splits Time Period vs Segment vs % Overall (steps 2–3) — period and cohort aren’t one muddled control.
Preset previous day/7d/30d/3m/year/Custom (step 3) — period-over-period without custom dates.
‘Compare to previous day’ chip + Past Avg + % deltas (steps 4–5) — narrative change at a glance.
mobbin:09f6e5da-eaa5-4633-9a33-231f80031.fit: Period-over-period for utilisation and faculty/learner KPIs — extends Performance Matrix without accreditation packs.
